analysis.title: U.S. Analyst Focus List Current Snapshot (12-NOV-26)
key_insights: The Analyst Focus List is JPMorgan's monthly set of top ideas from US equity analysts across growth, income, value and short strategies. It is a full monthly refresh and is not a model portfolio. Ideas can differ from JPMorgan's fundamental ratings.

The 12 Nov 2026 snapshot lists 69 names. 68 are rated Overweight and one, Gaming and Leisure Properties (GLPI), is Neutral. Almost all are tagged Growth or Value, with Annaly (NLY) and GLPI tagged Income. No short ideas appear in this snapshot.

Healthcare is the largest sector with 15 names, mostly Growth. Several are small-cap biotechs with price targets far above the current price, for example Olema (OLMA) at $46 vs an $8.04 close and Cogent (COGT) at $61 vs $29.40.

Nine names were added in the last four weeks: Sterling Infrastructure (STRL) 11/10, Meta (META) 11/9, Howmet (HWM), Quebecor (QBR/B CN) and Moody's (MCO) on 11/2, Palantir (PLTR) 10/29, Dollar General (DG) and Tango Therapeutics (TNGX) 10/26, and Rhythm (RYTM) 10/15.

Eleven names were removed in the last four weeks. Alphabet (GOOGL and GOOG) and DraftKings (DKNG) came off 11/9. Boeing (BA), Xenon (XENE) and T-Mobile (TMUS) came off 11/2. First Industrial (FR) came off 10/30, Boston Scientific (BSX) and S&P Global (SPGI) 10/28, Dollar Tree (DLTR) 10/26 and Fervo (FRVO) 10/19.

The two worst removals vs add price were DraftKings (added at $33.16, removed at $18.51, Neutral, PT $21) and Fervo (added at $37.22, removed at $9.68, PT $27). Boston Scientific was removed at $42.43 vs a $52.80 add price.

Largest long-run winners on the list by total return since add date: Eli Lilly (LLY) +1034.40% since 3/12/19, Carvana (CVNA) +269.35%, Revolution Medicines (RVMD) +204.52%, Broadcom (AVGO) +182.35%, Guidewire (GWRE) +160.39%, SharkNinja (SN) +154.12% and Caterpillar (CAT) +139.94%.

Largest laggards by total return since add date: Olema (OLMA) -70.38%, Celanese-adjacent consumer name McCormick (MKC) -32.02%, Celebrity-brand Celsius (CELH) -29.01%, Liberty Energy (LBRT) -29.20%, AGCO -22.43% and Cogent (COGT) -16.67%.

Tenable (TENB) is the only name trading above its price target: $42.93 close vs a $41.00 target, upside of -4.50%. Victoria's Secret (VSXY) has 0.13% upside to its $110 target and Macerich (MAC) 2.44%.

Largest implied upside to target: Olema (OLMA) 472.14%, Cogent (COGT) 107.48%, Amer Sports (AS) 105.92%, Sterling Infrastructure (STRL) 92.53%, ORIC 188.89%, Tango (TNGX) 82.67% and Cytokinetics (CYTK) 75.98%.
All price targets carry a Dec-27 end date. Mega-cap targets include Meta $940, Amazon $365, Broadcom $580, Eli Lilly $1,650 and Caterpillar $1,000.

Table data has apparent errors. Curbline (CURB) shows a market cap of $3,601.9bn, and KLA (KLAC) shows a relative return of -182.79% against a +12.01% total return. Quebecor's target is C$85.00 in the main table but C$80.00 in the additions table as of the add date, and Rhythm's is $142 in the main table vs $145 as of add date.
JPMorgan ratings distribution as of 3 Oct 2026: global coverage is 53% Overweight, 35% Neutral and 12% Underweight.

Names can be removed mid-month if a valuation target is largely met, if the original rationale no longer holds, or if a stock goes under research restriction.
Ideas can differ from JPMorgan's fundamental ratings, and performance figures are absolute and relative to the S&P 500, excluding commissions.
